verdict.rationale: Sketch documents a built-in local MCP server that lets AI clients like Claude or ChatGPT interact directly with Sketch, and says any frame can be built out in code with 1:1 visual fidelity. That covers the core agent-pulls-design-context workflow. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of exposing variables, screenshots, and component/code mappings to the agent; details of the MCP tool surface; independent or hands-on corroboration; a remote, non-local API path (no OpenAPI found).
